column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/StfsTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 34 automatic, 33 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:the two fixture files are written into a ScratchDir through test::write_file, each write an ASSERT_OK carrying the old "fixture file must be writable" message

ported;note:the four POSIX checks are 5 EXPECTs here (the kept path as EXPECT_OK plus EXPECT_EQ on value_or, so the rejections still run); the 11 old sites count each fails_with inside its require twice and include the two #ifdef _WIN32 checks, which are the new case StfsSafeJoin.WindowsDriveRelativeAndUncPathsAreRejected

new;note:the two #ifdef _WIN32 checks of test_safe_join (a drive-relative and a UNC path rejected with InvalidArgument) as a case of their own that GTEST_SKIPs elsewhere, so it is listed on every platform
ported;note:the loop over the three sizes stays one case, each size under SCOPED_TRACE (the same sizes are the rows Row/StfsErrorCode OpenHeaderSize0x100, 0x100000 and 0xFFFFF000)
ported;note:the loop over the two separator names stays inside the case, each name under SCOPED_TRACE

ported;note:its own unbundled suite; the silent "(skipped: no /dev/full)" print and return becomes GTEST_SKIP(), so ctest reports it as Skipped; the planted directory and link to /dev/full are ASSERTed (they threw before)

ported;note:the package is read once per process (function-local const Result, missing fixture = FAIL); the per-entry checks run under SCOPED_TRACE(entry.name) and the two SHA-1s come from test::sha1_hex
ported;note:shares the once-read package with FixtureListsItsFilesAndExtractsThemByteIdentically; the case-sensitive "$flash_" strip is kept verbatim

ported;note:renders twice (EXPECT_EQ, the old "two renderings differ" require) then matches_golden("stfs_su20076000_entries") on the whole file; render_entry_snapshot moves verbatim into tests/snapshots/StfsSystemUpdateGoldenTests.cpp, its two requires now returned as Errors so GX_GOLDEN registers it; the two counted requires (31 entries, every file hashed) are the case EveryOneOf31EntriesIsHashed (row .Counts); the 11.8 MB package is read once per process and the suite is one bundled entry
new;note:the entries == 31 and hashed == files requires of test_system_update_fixture_entry_snapshot (old lines 1047-1048) as a case of their own beside the golden compare, two EXPECTs

ported;note:renders twice (EXPECT_EQ) then matches_golden("stfs_su20076000_metadata") on the whole file; render_metadata_snapshot moves verbatim, its two requires now returned as Errors; the printed field count is the case MetadataFieldsAreRendered (row .Fields)
new;note:the old binary only printed "metadata fields rendered N" (43); the case asserts at least one field and one golden line per field

merged:Stfs.error_cases.OpenCONMagicFullSizeBuffer;note:its loop over error_cases() is TEST_P StfsErrorCode.FailsWithItsPinnedCode (EXPECT_ERROR on the code, plus EXPECT_ERROR_HAS where must_contain is set): the 32 rows in today's order are bundled as stfs.Row/StfsErrorCode, the /dev/full row is its own instantiation NeedsDevFull/StfsErrorCode (discovered per row, skipped without /dev/full); every row runs instead of being collected into one failure list

ported;note:row FreeExtractFileToDiskDevFull, the only row of the NeedsDevFull instantiation, discovered as its own ctest entry (PER_ROW); the fixture SetUp GTEST_SKIPs it without /dev/full where the old loop printed "not compared"

new;note:names the plan-then-write order of StfsContainer::extract_all (N5): a trailing "." directory (InvalidArgument "STFS entry . has an empty path") or a trailing forward parent reference (Malformed "STFS file table entry 2 references an invalid parent index 3") after good files fails before even the output directory is created

new;note:names the range check the old test_verify_detects_corruption made in one line (N5): in the 0xD000-byte synthetic package logical block 0x100 fails verify_data_block with OutOfRange "level-0 hash table at 0xB6000 is outside the package" (the hash table is checked first), the verified extract adds "verifying block 256 in file a.bin", and the unverified extract fails OutOfRange at data block 259 (0x10D000)

new;note:names the 0x1000 round-up of the header size in block_to_offset (N5): 0xA000 stays, 0xA001 and 0x9001 round up, and a synthetic package declaring the real-world 0x971A keeps header_size() 0x971A while its chained file extracts with verification against the rounded 0xA000 base

new;note:names the extract_to_memory key rule of StfsContainer.cpp:34-39 (N5), untested before because the fixture's names are all lower case and the old helper (StfsTests.cpp:770) stripped case-sensitively: $FLASH_Dash.XEX keys as dash.xex and Other.BIN as other.bin; exclusions match keys as given (DASH.XEX excludes nothing); contains_file_by_name and extract_file_by_name lowercase the wanted name but never strip the prefix, so $flash_dash.xex is NotFound
